groupings.abs_reference_g_quintile: pooled unweighted empirical quintiles of abs(g), NumPy linear quantiles at 20/40/60/80%; ties go to the higher bin via searchsorted(side=right)
groupings.block: the four frozen RUN4 block IDs; include all blocks, including one-class 303003
groupings.cue_incidence_pattern: four incidence bits in stored absolute cue-slot order; bit c is tuple[c].incidence; pattern integer is sum(bit_c<<c)
groupings.leverage_quintile: pooled unweighted empirical quintiles of q*abs(native proposed delta)*abs(g), same quantile/tie rule
groupings.native_magnitude_quintile: pooled unweighted empirical quintiles of abs(native proposed delta), same quantile/tie rule

native_magnitude: m=abs(native proposed delta) from the locked RUN4 scoring truth
prediction_sign_rule: +1 when held-out logit > 0; otherwise -1, matching RUN4 scoring
row_leverage_weight: w=q*m*abs(g), where q is the frozen inclusion weight
row_population: all 13,420 existing RUN4 U* rows; no refitting, resampling, or row exclusion
target_sign: y=+1 when g>0 else -1; all RUN4 rows are on the already-frozen nonzero target channel
uncertainty: none; this is a deterministic decomposition of the already-opened RUN4 qualification predictions, not an inferential estimate
